Ambiguous words require context review. These are language items, not additional official exam questions. Zero-occurrence items are supplementary curriculum.

phrases.reading_note_en: Permission, not an instruction to do it.
The whole negative chunk changes the meaning.

Read whether the question asks what is prohibited.
Do not confuse this with bị cấm.
In an obligation it means must; in bên phải or rẽ phải it means right. Never auto-gloss this word without context.

phrases.en: must carry out; must comply with

phrases.en: in the direction of the arrows

Identify the vehicle types and their intended movements.

Upper limit, not minimum.
Lower limit, not maximum.
In a threshold it can mean above; elsewhere it can mean on. Read the whole phrase.
Keep the negative when interpreting a numerical limit.
